mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the temperature and door-opening logs was the most worthwhile decision: it offered a plausible explanation for most spikes while making clear that air readings do not establish what every stored item experienced.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final inspection felt a little redundant: I had already considered pairing the forecast with the monitored cooler, and inspection confirmed and automatically performed that pairing.

surprise.text: The service record revealed a renewal warning even though the repaired cabinet held its range, shifting attention from the repair to the reliability of its supply.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. I was uncertain what to do with the aligned logs, but inspecting them exposed the connection to Moth.

continue.text: Yes. The repair and evidence comparison were satisfying, and the unresolved supply warning makes me interested in how the clinic secures a fallback.
